name: nexpulse-ai
description: NEXPULSE AI — The Pulse of Every Platform. AI-powered social media analytics.

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix server install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.build: npm --prefix client run build && npm --prefix server run build && npm run build:sdk
scripts.lint: npm --prefix client run lint && npm --prefix server run lint
scripts.lint:fix: npm --prefix client run lint:fix && npm --prefix server run lint:fix
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix client run typecheck && npm --prefix server run typecheck
scripts.test: npm --prefix client run test && npm --prefix server run test && npm run test:sdk-ts && npm run test:sdk-python
scripts.security:scan: npm run security:secrets && npm run security:sast && npm run security:sbom && npm run security:container && npm run security:dependencies
